{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify and correct the invalid age values (negative ages)
# Replace negative ages with NaN
invalid_age_mask = df['customer_age'] < 0
df_cleaned = df.copy()
df_cleaned.loc[invalid_age_mask, 'customer_age'] = None

# Calculate the mean age after removing invalid ages
mean_age_cleaned = df_cleaned['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_cleaned"}
